subject: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)

Team —

We need to lock the planning cadence and scenario owners this week so the QBR packet can be finalized for Exec review on May 10. Big-picture asks:

- Confirm target bands (base / stretch / downside) per org by May 4.
- Assign one owner for each scenario (growth, base, conservative). Owners should be able to produce a 1-pager and a contingency trigger matrix.
- Agree cadence for review: I propose weekly planning scrums through May 14, then bi-weekly through June.

Attached is a light runway model (v2) and a strawman QBR checklist. Please take 30m to review and send your owners + target thoughts. We should surface any major gating issues (sales bookings cadence, Dedicated capacity commitments, Private deployment deals) in this thread.

Quick notes from my side: 
- We should treat Nimbus Health as a priority account for FY28 target modeling; procurement timeline looks tight (see external thread below).
- If we expect >25% of bookings from a small set of ID firms, we need explicit downside mitigations.

Next steps: replies with owners/target bands by EOD May 4. I'll consolidate and push a final plan into the shared Drive.

Thanks —
Jonas
VP, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)

Jonas —

Agree with the cadence. Quick replies on owners / targets:

- Sales targets: Marissa to own the growth/base numbers (has the territory rollups).
- Commercial ops / bookings cadence: Laura (me) will own the downside scenario triggers and the contingency playbook.
- Platform / Infra cost targets: Vivek to own quantization / cost-reduction levers and the capacity forecast.

Attached: I updated the runway model with a bookings waterfall and a conservative revenue shock. See tab "BookingsShock".

Two asks:
1) Marissa — can you pull the top 10 accounts by expected ARR for FY28 and flag concentration risk by May 3?
2) Soojin — can you draft a short note for Exec on OKR stretch adjustments if we trigger the conservative runway?

I'll start the contingency matrix doc and link it to the Drive folder once Jonas confirms cadence.

- Laura
Head of Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027_runway_model_v2.xlsx (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)

Thanks — note on targets and timing:

- Growth band: +40% ARR target assumes two mid-market expansions (Nimbus-style) and uplift from Hosted API upsells. I can own the evidence package for those assumptions.
- Base: +18% is probably achievable given current pipeline and a conservative close rate; will validate with AE leaders by EOD May 3.
- Downside: -6% requires us to model a 40% hit to time-to-close for top deals; Laura, my top-10 list is in progress, will share by EOD.

On cadence: weekly scrums through May 14 sounds right; propose we use Wed 9–10am PT for the recurring sync and keep Thurs for 1:1 deep dives with owners.

Question for Jonas: do we want to include a separate staffing cushion in the model (1.5% of ARR) for Dedicated onboarding overhead? That would change infrastructure asks in the QBR.

—Marissa
GM, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)

Laura / Jonas —

Quick update from Nimbus: procurement confirmed a vendor-review window the week of May 17, but legal asks for a draft SOW at least 7 business days before review. If Redwood can produce a draft SOW and a light architecture diagram by May 10, we should be in scope for their June procurement cycle.

I attached a short procurement checklist they provided. We're trying to keep timelines tight — happy to sync 30m this week to unblock.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Digital Platforms
Nimbus Health

Attachment: nimbus_procurement_checklist.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual planning: runway & cadence decisions (targets, QBR prep)

Thanks, all — good alignment. Quick consolidated plan: 

1) Owners: Marissa (growth evidence), Laura (downside & contingency), Vivek (platform cost levers), Soojin (OKR stretch comms). Please confirm by EOD May 3 — I have Marissa and Laura confirmed; Vivek/Soojin please reply.
2) Cadence: Weekly Wed 9–10am PT starting May 5 through May 14; bi-weekly starting May 21. Calendar invites will be sent after owners are finalized.
3) Deliverables for May 10 Exec packet: 1-pager per scenario (owner-owned), updated runway model, QBR checklist, and 1-slide concentration-risk summary.
4) Nimbus ask: Laura / Marissa — prioritize the draft SOW + arch diagram to hit Alice's May 10 ask. I'll join the sync if needed.

I've uploaded the working folder and checklist to Drive (link below). If there are major objections to the cadence or deliverables, flag here. Otherwise I'll publish the invites and consolidate the May 10 packet.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-prep

-Jonas
VP, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
